spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 The emanation of truth that proceeds from
 the Divine will and is received into
 the understanding:
 interior
 affection elevates it from within,
 the
 faculty of articulate
 thought
 extends it into distinct forms, the
 power of natural discernment separ
ates it into its particulars, and
 the outermost containment of
 the
 sens
ory mind
 gathers it into final
 unity.
 Truth proceeds through the operation of these five
 successive
 degrees and
 becomes perceptible to the external
 mind.

**¶2:**
 So
 it
 is with truth formed into
 communicable knowledge: at the first degree
 it is poured forth from its interior
 source in
 love;
 at the second it is consolidated and made
 firm through
 the
 understanding
; at the third it is refined,
 turned
 upon
 itself, and shaped to its proper proportion
; at the fourth the authentic character
 of its origin is impressed upon it;
 and at the fifth it is purified
 and made clear. These five operations of
 the Divine order shape and perfect each communic
able truth, and it enters the common
 understanding of humanity. It becomes a spiritual
 possession —
 truth
 that can be received into the mind and
 given forth to others.

**
¶3:** This is the
 nature of all
 truth: it is formed and perfected
 through five successive degrees of spiritual
 order. It proceeds forth from
 its
 source
 and is received into the understanding of those
 who stand
 without
.

[For the breast shall bring it forth from within,] and the throat draws it up and the tongue spreads it out and the teeth cut it and the lips g[at]her it! The word shall come forth through the power of th[ese five] members and be heard outside.
This is also the case with the [wor]d, as it is formed and embellished by five [member]s. It comes forth and is heard by the ears [of] others.

Simila[rly] the coin: One shall pour it out and an [othe]r beat it and another trim it as it is turned, and a[nother] put the stamp on it and another wipe it in the sieve (?). [Behold], these five craftsmen shall shape and beautify [their] coin, and it comes amongst mankind. It becomes a posse[ssion] to be received and given.
